$comment: Single source of truth for Beach Day decision logic. Every implementation (Hubitat/TRMNL Liquid, reTerminal firmware) must produce identical verdicts from identical inputs. Change a value here first, then update each implementation and note it in shared/README.md.

activeBeachHours.$comment: Hourly forecast rows inside this inclusive local-hour window feed the sun scan (first sunny hour, weather-code mode) and today's max precipitation probability. NOT the AQI window — see aqiDaylightWindow.

aqiDaylightWindow.$comment: AQI min/max use a different window from the other aggregates: hourly us_aqi rows whose local hour is between the sunrise hour and the sunset hour, both inclusive, integer hours (sunrise 06:41 -> 6, sunset 19:52 -> 19). Falls back to 06-20 if sunrise/sunset are unavailable.

inputAggregation.$comment: How each rule input is derived from Open-Meteo. Today and tomorrow are NOT symmetric; implementations must match this, not tidy it.
inputAggregation.temp: daily temperature_2m_max for the target day
inputAggregation.windSpeed: daily wind_speed_10m_max for the target day
inputAggregation.uvIndex: daily uv_index_max for the target day
inputAggregation.precipProbability.today: max hourly precipitation_probability over activeBeachHours today
inputAggregation.precipProbability.tomorrow: daily precipitation_probability_max for tomorrow (whole day, not activeBeachHours)
inputAggregation.aqi: max hourly us_aqi over aqiDaylightWindow for the target day
inputAggregation.aqiMin: min hourly us_aqi over aqiDaylightWindow for the target day
inputAggregation.humidityMin/Max: min/max hourly relative_humidity_2m over all 24 hours of the target day
inputAggregation.activeWeatherCode: mode of hourly weather_code over activeBeachHours for the target day; ties go to the LOWER code; falls back to daily weather_code if no rows
inputAggregation.hourlyRows: every hourly row for the target day whose local hour is in activeBeachHours, as (hour, weather_code)

sunnyWeatherCodeMax.$comment: WMO codes <= this count as sun: 0 clear, 1 mainly clear, 2 partly cloudy.

clearingDeadlineHour.$comment: First sunny hour must be at or before this local hour to satisfy the forecast condition. 14 = 2 PM.

beachDayConditions.$comment: ALL must pass for a Beach Day. Operators are applied as: <metric> <op> <value>.

forecast.$comment: Passes if the active daily weather code is sunny, OR the first sunny hour is at/before clearingDeadlineHour.

time.$comment: Current local time must be between sunrise and sunset minus this buffer. If sunrise/sunset are unavailable (0), this condition passes.

nightMode.$comment: When the time condition fails, the whole display flips to tomorrow's forecast and re-evaluates every condition against tomorrow's values.

states.$comment: Evaluated top-down; the FIRST match wins. Each entry's condition assumes all earlier entries did not match.

priority.title: Nice Day
priority.subtitle: But not quite beachy
priority.condition: temp >= 65 AND temp < 75 AND forecast condition passes
priority.$comment: Evaluated at the same precedence level as chilly_day (both gated only on beach/night/indoor/rain/wind not matching). temp ranges are disjoint, so they cannot both match.

parkingAlert.$comment: Street cleaning restrictions. When active, the alert replaces the sunset/time metadata line. Window opens at sunset the evening before the restriction day and closes at endTime on the restriction day.

activeWindow.opensAt: sunset on the day before the restriction day
activeWindow.$comment2: sunsetFallbackMinutes = 19:30 local, used when sunset is unavailable.

parkingAlert.textFormatNote: The start meridiem is dropped when start and end share it, e.g. '8-10AM'.

rounding.$comment: All values are rounded to the nearest integer before display.
